actions.name: review_page
actions.doc: Check one page of the sample app against the design system: text contrast, corners, type, focus, labels that can't wrap, and engine.py review's hard-coded colours and spacing. Each check is pass, look or broken, with a short fix when there is one. Yields the result as each check lands.

actions.name: fix_check
actions.doc: Apply one review fix to the sample app (a scratch copy in work/): a hard-coded colour becomes a token, a gap moves onto the scale, or a label is allowed to wrap. Changes the page; Undo puts it back.

actions.name: undo_fix
actions.doc: Take back one fix to the sample app: its CSS goes back to what it was before.

actions.name: suggest_parts
actions.doc: The component library's best parts for one kind of page (3 to 5): name, what each is for, its kind and style, and whether it uses only your design tokens.

actions.name: add_part
actions.doc: Add one library part to the project's kit (a scratch folder in work/kit): its HTML, ready to use with your tokens. Undo removes it.

actions.name: remove_part
actions.doc: Take one part back out of the kit.

actions.name: token_use
actions.doc: How much of the sample app's CSS uses the design tokens: values that come from var(--ds-*) and values typed by hand, in total and per kind (colour, spacing, corners, type, shadows), as counts and percentages, with each value typed by hand and where it is.

actions.name: define
actions.doc: What one design-system word means, in plain words, from OpenDesigner's glossary: the definition, other names for it, and what designers and code call it.

actions.name: preview_corners
actions.doc: What changing the corner radius one step would do, without changing anything: each radius token before and after, and how many places use them.

actions.name: change_corners
actions.doc: Change the design system's corner radius one step (rounder or sharper) with the engine, on the scratch copy of the system: every radius token moves together. Changes the system; Undo puts it back.

actions.name: undo_corners
actions.doc: Take back a corner change: the system's state and tokens go back to what they were before it.
